mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN REASON = 'CHALLENGE_REWARD' THEN AMOUNT ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) + FLOOR( COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN REASON = 'MARKET_SALES' THEN AMOUNT ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) / 10 ) FROM POINT_LOG WHERE MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} AND TYPE = 'SAVED' AND REASON IN ('CHALLENGE_REWARD', 'MARKET_SALES')
